connector.name: LinkedIn Decision Maker Finder
connector.registryDescription: Find decision makers at any company: name, job title and LinkedIn profile URL. No login needed.
connector.summary: Hosted at piotrv1001--linkedin-decision-maker-finder.apify.actor over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the piotrv1001 account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN> — your own Apify API token from https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Usage is billed to your Apify account.
